rows.ja: 供給元(半導体・電力・計算)
競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: 液冷のGrace Blackwell GPUを数十万基導入し、Vera Rubinを動かす最初の大手クラウドになるとMicrosoftが説明
relations.text_en: Says it has deployed hundreds of thousands of liquid-cooled Grace Blackwell GPUs and will be first to power on Vera Rubin

source.label: Microsoft ブログ(2026年3月)
source.quote: we’ve deployed hundreds of thousands of liquid-cooled Grace Blackwell GPUs across our global datacenter footprint, and now we are excited to be the first hyperscale cloud to power on NVIDIA’s newest Vera Rubin NVL72 in our labs
source.note: Vera Rubinのデータセンター導入はこれからの話です。
source.note_en: Vera Rubin rollout is described as upcoming.

relations.text: NVIDIAが年次報告で、AI計算機能を自社の仕組みに組み込む企業の1社としてMicrosoftを挙げている
relations.text_en: NVIDIA’s annual report names Microsoft among companies building accelerated/AI computing into their own solutions

source.label: NVIDIA 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: such as Alibaba Group, Alphabet Inc., Amazon, Inc., or Amazon, Baidu, Inc., Huawei, and Microsoft Corporation, or Microsoft

relations.text: AMDのHeliosとEPYCをAzureのAI・HPC向け仮想マシンに導入
relations.text_en: Bringing AMD’s Helios platform and next-generation EPYC to Azure AI and HPC VMs

source.label: Microsoft ブログ(2026年7月)
source.quote: Microsoft is bringing AMD’s latest Helios AI platform and next-generation EPYC datacenter processors to Azure.
source.note: 提供開始はこれからです。

relations.text: 自社AIチップMaia 300の計算チップレットをTSMCのN2Pで製造
relations.text_en: Maia 300 compute chiplets are built on TSMC’s N2P process

source.label: Microsoft ブログ(2026年10月)
source.quote: Compute chiplets are built on TSMC’s N2P process node to maximize performance-per-watt.

relations.text: Microsoftが選んだチップ設計を、Intel 18Aで生産する計画
relations.text_en: Microsoft chose a chip design it plans to produce on Intel 18A

source.label: Intel ニュースルーム(2024年2月)
source.quote: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella shares that Microsoft has chosen a chip design it plans to produce on the Intel 18A process.
source.note: 2024年2月時点の計画で、製品名は示されていません。
source.note_en: A plan as of Feb 2024; the product is not named.

relations.text: Intelが年次報告で、自社設計の半導体を開発する大手クラウド企業の1社としてMicrosoftを挙げ、競合として扱っている
relations.text_en: Intel’s annual report names Microsoft among hyperscalers developing their own custom silicon, which it lists as competition

source.label: Intel 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: companies developing their own custom silicon, including many hyperscalers such as Amazon, Google, Meta and Microsoft

relations.text: ニュージャージー州のデータセンターで、専用GPU基盤を5年間Microsoftに提供
relations.text_en: Provides dedicated GPU capacity at its Vineland, New Jersey data center over five years

source.label: Nebius 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: entered into a commercial agreement with Microsoft Corp (“Microsoft”), pursuant to which we are providing Microsoft access to dedicated GPU infrastructure capacity in clusters at our new data center in Vineland, New Jersey over a five-year term.
source.note: 契約額は最大約174億ドルと見積もられ、導入状況などに左右されます。
source.note_en: Contract value estimated at up to about $17.4B, subject to deployment and other conditions.

relations.text: CoreWeaveが年次報告で、最大の顧客としてMicrosoftを挙げている
relations.text_en: CoreWeave’s annual report says Microsoft was its top customer, about 67% of its 2025 revenue

source.label: CoreWeave 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We recognized an aggregate of approximately 67% of our revenue from our top customer, Microsoft, for the year ended December 31, 2025.

relations.text: スリーマイル島1号機の再稼働に伴う20年の電力購入契約
relations.text_en: 20-year power purchase agreement tied to the restart of Three Mile Island Unit 1

source.label: Constellation の発表(2024年9月)
source.quote: announced today the signing of a 20-year power purchase agreement with Microsoft that will pave the way for the launch of the Crane Clean Energy Center (CCEC) and restart of Three Mile Island Unit 1
source.note: 再稼働には規制当局の承認が必要です。
source.note_en: Restart is subject to regulatory approvals.

relations.text: OpenAIと長期の戦略的提携。持分法投資で、出資比率は約25%
relations.text_en: Long-term strategic partnership with OpenAI; equity-method investment of about 25%

source.label: Microsoft 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: We have an investment accounted for under the equity method that represents an approximate 25 % interest on an as-converted basis.
source.note: OpenAIは非上場で、再編や追加の資金調達で持分は薄まっています。
source.note_en: OpenAI is private; ownership is diluted by recapitalization and funding.

relations.text: 2026年4月に契約を見直し、Microsoftは引き続きOpenAIの主要クラウドで、新製品はまずAzureで提供
relations.text_en: April 2026 amendment: Microsoft remains OpenAI’s primary cloud partner and products ship first on Azure

source.label: Microsoft ブログ(2026年4月)
source.quote: Microsoft remains OpenAI’s primary cloud partner, and OpenAI products will ship first on Azure

relations.text: OpenAIがAzureを追加で2,500億ドル分購入すると契約
relations.text_en: OpenAI contracted to purchase an incremental $250B of Azure services

source.label: Microsoft ブログ(2025年10月)
source.quote: OpenAI has contracted to purchase an incremental $250B of Azure services

relations.text: AnthropicがAzureの計算容量を300億ドル分購入すると約束し、Microsoftは最大50億ドルを出資
relations.text_en: Anthropic committed to buy $30B of Azure compute; Microsoft to invest up to $5B

source.label: Microsoft ブログ(2025年11月)
source.quote: NVIDIA and Microsoft are committing to invest up to $10 billion and up to $5 billion respectively in Anthropic.
source.note: 出資額は「最大」の数字で、Anthropicは非上場です。
source.note_en: “Up to” investment amount; Anthropic is private.

relations.text: 「RISE with SAP on Microsoft Azure」の共同プログラムを世界で拡大
relations.text_en: Expanded the global RISE with SAP on Microsoft Azure joint program

source.label: SAP ニュース(2026年5月)
source.quote: Microsoft and SAP are excited to announce the expansion of the global RISE with SAP on Microsoft Azure initiative, a joint program between Microsoft and SAP

companies.name: Oracle
companies.sub: データベース・クラウド

relations.text: Azureのデータセンター内でOracleのデータベースサービスを提供する「Oracle Database@Azure」
relations.text_en: Oracle Database@Azure: Oracle database services on OCI inside Azure datacenters

source.label: Microsoft Source(2023年9月)
source.quote: Oracle Corp and Microsoft Corp today announced Oracle Database@Azure, which gives customers direct access to Oracle database services running on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and deployed in Microsoft Azure datacenters.

source.quote: large companies that incorporate security or observability features in their products, such as Alphabet Inc., Cisco Systems, Inc., and Microsoft Corporation

source.label: Fortinet 10-K
source.quote: Microsoft Corporation (“Microsoft”), Netskope Inc.

relations.text_en: MongoDB’s annual report names Microsoft among its competitors

source.label: MongoDB 10-K
source.quote: We primarily compete with established legacy database software providers such as IBM, Microsoft, Oracle and other similar companies.

relations.text: Boxが年次報告で、競合としてMicrosoftを挙げている
relations.text_en: Box’s annual report names Microsoft among its competitors

source.label: Box 10-K
source.quote: In the content management market, our primary competitors include, but are not limited to, Microsoft (SharePoint) and OpenText (Documentum).

relations.text_en: Dropbox’s annual report names Microsoft among its competitors

source.label: Dropbox 10-K
source.quote: compete in the cloud storage market with products offered by Microsoft, Amazon, Apple, Google, and Adobe
